name: Jared Kushner
description: Follow Jared Kushner, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Russia Bombards Kyiv Soon After Witkoff, Kushner Leave
changes.summary: Russia agreed not to bomb Ukraine’s capital during Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner’s visit there. The respite was short-lived.

changes.title: U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine
changes.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded. (Image credit: Francisco Seco).

changes.title: Witkoff, Kushner visit Moscow in latest push to end war in Ukraine
changes.summary: Presidents Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy agreed to pause strikes on each other's capitals while U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner hold talks to revive peace efforts.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Jared Kushner first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Kushner and Witkoff to Go to Russia and Ukraine to Revive Peace Talks
changes.summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff’s trip to meet with the countries’ presidents comes at a precarious moment in the Ukraine conflict.

changes.title: Russian Drone Strikes Office of Ukraine’s Intelligence Chief
changes.summary: The attack came as the American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were said to be planning imminent visits to Kyiv and to Moscow.
